abe.name: Abe
abe.role: Island fisher; calm, stubborn compassion, plain-spoken

dash.name: Dash
dash.role: Young scavenger; playful confidence hiding a fear of heights

tc.abe.hello.text: You crossed safely. Good. The climb to Sunspire starts here.

choices.text: I am trying to reach Sunspire.

effects.title: The path above the sea
effects.text: Sunspire stands beyond the upper cliffs. Repair the cargo lift brake below, then climb the eastern steps and release its top catch. Abe waits near the landing.

voice.speaker: abe
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: On the island below Sunspire, helping a traveler reach the palace and free a chained sea creature.

tc.abe.path.text: Fit the spare brake wheel below the cargo lift. Climb the steps and release its upper catch. Then you can ride it.

voice.speaker: abe
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: On the island below Sunspire, helping a traveler reach the palace and free a chained sea creature.

tc.abe.wait.text: I'll watch the boat. Take care on the climb.

choices.text: Tell me about the creature above.

voice.speaker: abe
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: On the island below Sunspire, helping a traveler reach the palace and free a chained sea creature.

tc.abe.beast.text: The Legion chained a hydra across the climb. It attacks because the chains hurt it—not because it serves them.

effects.title: What holds it here
effects.text: The hydra is trapped, not Hollowed. Inspect the discarded shackle on the middle ledge. Its worn joints may show how to break the neck restraints safely.

choices.text: Three heads sound hard to reason with.

voice.speaker: abe
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: On the island below Sunspire, helping a traveler reach the palace and free a chained sea creature.

tc.abe.reason.text: Free it before deciding it has to die.

choices.text: Show me what to look for.

effects.title: What holds it here
effects.text: Find the discarded shackle beside the middle ledge. Look for worn joints. The Legion uses the trapped hydra to block the path to Sunspire.

voice.speaker: abe
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: On the island below Sunspire, helping a traveler reach the palace and free a chained sea creature.

tc.abe.chains.text: Inspect the old shackle on the middle ledge. Break the new neck shackles while the hydra rests. It may leave once free.

choices.text: I will look for the weak joints.

voice.speaker: abe
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: On the island below Sunspire, helping a traveler reach the palace and free a chained sea creature.

tc.abe.farewell.text: You helped a creature that could have killed you. Remember that kindness when you reach the palace.

voice.speaker: abe
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: On the island below Sunspire, helping a traveler reach the palace and free a chained sea creature.

tc.dash.hello.text: This is my treasure claim. The stick makes it official. Probably.

effects.title: Dash’s claim
effects.text: Dash found a sealed wreck cave beyond the western rock arch. Help him open its two catches, or follow his marked route challenge. The cave may contain a Rift Shard.

voice.speaker: dash
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: On the island below Sunspire, helping a traveler reach the palace and free a chained sea creature.

tc.dash.offer.text: Help open the wreck cave and split the coins. Or beat my cliff race to keep them all.

choices.text: We split the coins. Show me the catches.

voice.speaker: dash
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: On the island below Sunspire, helping a traveler reach the palace and free a chained sea creature.

tc.dash.help.text: Brace the lower catch open, then turn the upper wheel. One person can do it.

voice.speaker: dash
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: On the island below Sunspire, helping a traveler reach the palace and free a chained sea creature.

tc.dash.race.text: Touch flags 1, 2 and 3, then ring the cave bell within two minutes. Return here to retry.

choices.text: Maybe we should just work together.

voice.speaker: dash
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: On the island below Sunspire, helping a traveler reach the palace and free a chained sea creature.

tc.dash.done.text: You earned those coins. That climb was worth watching.

choices.text: Keep the stick. It suits you.

voice.speaker: dash

voice.context: On the island below Sunspire, helping a traveler reach the palace and free a chained sea creature.

effects.title: The broken lift
effects.text: The brake wheel is fitted. Climb the eastern steps and release the catch at the upper landing.

effects.title: Cargo lift restored
effects.text: The cargo lift now connects the landing to the middle ledge. Use either station to travel. The discarded shackle lies nearby.

effects.title: Worn neck joints
effects.text: The shackle is worn thin at its joint. Wait until a hydra head finishes its attack, then strike the pale joint on that neck restraint. Each broken chain frees one head. The raised flank stones give another route around its low sweep. The animal does not need to die.

effects.title: The upper path
effects.text: The barrier is open. The hydra blocks the last climb toward Sunspire. Finish exploring these cliffs before entering its ledges.

effects.title: An honest split
effects.text: Dash kept his word. The wreck cave is open; its Rift Shard must be collected in person.

effects.title: Dash’s cliff route
effects.text: The route challenge is complete. The wreck cave is open. Each explorer must collect the shard inside.

effects.title: A sailor’s cape
effects.text: A cream and blue cape made from old sailcloth. Finish Thunder Cliffs to keep it, then equip it at the Keeper.

effects.title: The carved tide marks
effects.text: Three stones show the sea rising: one wave, two waves, three waves. A worn groove links them to the inland rock door.

effects.title: The high shelf
effects.text: The high side climb has a steady wind cycle. White streaks gather before a gust. Wait on the wide rests, then jump between the narrow stones. Lower ledges catch missed jumps; dropping to the bottom catch returns you to the climb entrance.
